name: cooling-tower-sizing-process
description: Observable use of the supplied thermal sizing methodology, scored independently of final artifact reward.

dimensions.criterion: Observable implementation distinguishes dry-air mass, wet-air density, total versus per-fan quantities and consistent engineering units.
Visible calculations or checks pair physically adjacent counterflow endpoint states and check the full driving-force profile before accepting a thermal integral.
Visible work connects candidate feasibility to selected air flow, aerodynamic pressure and installed drive adequacy without forcing a successful result.
Observable workbook construction binds derived values to source input cells and maintains coupled recalculation rather than writing a baseline snapshot.
Visible execution recalculates with a spreadsheet engine and tests distinct boundary changes including a feasibility or adequacy transition.

level_anchors.0: No supporting visible execution, or the trajectory contradicts the method.
level_anchors.1: A limited substantive action is visible but most of the dimension is not implemented or checked.
level_anchors.2: The main method is partly implemented with visible evidence, but significant basis, coupling or validation gaps remain.
level_anchors.3: The method is implemented coherently and supported by visible execution, with a limited remaining gap.
level_anchors.4: The method is fully implemented and its relevant behavior is visibly checked with concrete artifacts or execution results.

judge_rules: Judge only supplied observable steps; every nonzero dimension requires supporting visible step IDs.
Opening, quoting or naming the skill earns no credit by itself.
Do not infer hidden reasoning, identity, model condition, reward or expected target performance.
Do not substitute final numerical correctness for evidence of procedural execution.
Return per-dimension levels and evidence only; the caller computes weighted normalized process score.
This contract has no fatal caps and cannot alter deterministic artifact reward.
